description: This file defines a template class 'PingPongEnabled' that provides WebSocket ping-pong functionality, including starting the ping process, handling pong responses and timeouts, and scheduling pings. It is likely used as a base class for WebSocket connection management in a project.

classes.name: PingPongEnabled
classes.description: A template class that adds ping-pong (heartbeat) functionality to a WebSocket connection. It manages scheduling pings, handling pong responses, and detecting timeouts.

methods.name: startPing
methods.description: Initializes the ping process by setting pong handlers and scheduling the first ping.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a future callback to send a ping after a specified interval.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends a ping frame over the WebSocket connection if it is open.

methods.name: onPong
methods.description: Handler invoked when a pong response is received; reschedules the next ping.

methods.name: onPongTimeout
methods.description: Handler invoked when a pong timeout occurs; triggers connection closure.

methods.name: printConnectionState
methods.description: Logs the current state of the WebSocket connection.
